title: Cranage
summary: CRANAGE, noun [from crane. Low Latin ] The liberty of using a crane at a wharf for raising wares from a vessel; also, the money or price paid for the use of a crane.

inlines.v: CRANAGE, noun [from crane. Low Latin ] The liberty of using a crane at a wharf for raising wares from a vessel; also, the money or price paid for the use of a crane.
